title: Minority probability
statement: For a Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, its minority probability is the smaller of the uniform probabilities that its value is $1$ and that its value is $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube.
